author: John Khan
source: John Khan's attachment '100 Features Women Want That Apps Don't Have' (Oct 23 2026), written out in plan/women-100-features.md; hand-entered facts only, no scores

features.name: Custom Palette Builder
features.summary: Mix your own shades; build and save personal palettes for eyes, blush and lips.
features.must: Shades stay true on deep skin — raise chroma, never lighten her skin to make a shade work. No palette that only works on light skin.

features.name: Palette Extraction From Any Photo
features.summary: Pull a wearable palette from a dress, a sunset, artwork — or another face photo.
features.must: Never auto-lighten her face to 'match' the photo; warn when an extracted shade will read ashy or orange on her depth.

features.name: Palette → Real Brand Shades + Cheaper Dupes
features.summary: Every custom shade resolved to products she can actually buy — premium and budget.
features.must: No sponsored ranking disguised as a match. ΔE and the undertone label are shown, especially for deep shades where catalogues are thinnest.
flags: BRAND DATA: real brand shades only via YouCam product data or written brand permission
until then own shade names
features.blocked_reason: No cleared, maintained real-brand shade and price catalogue is supplied. YouCam product data or written brand permission is required. Own digital swatches remain available without product or price equivalence claims.

features.name: Undertone-Based Palette Recommendations
features.summary: Seasonal palettes — warm/cool/neutral/olive, soft/bright/deep — built from her measured skin, not a quiz result.
features.must: Olive and neutral-olive are first-class. Deep skin gets the full chroma range, not just jewel tones.

features.name: Palette For An Outfit
features.summary: Photograph tonight's outfit; get makeup that harmonises with it and with her undertone.
features.must: Fabric sheen is not skin sheen. Never recommend a lip shade that disappears against a same-colour dress on deep skin.

features.name: Foundation Shade Finder With True Undertone
features.summary: Depth + undertone + formula-specific match, with a confidence score and a 2-shade test plan.
features.engine: New tech — calibrated CE-4; then powers ~40 features
features.must: Publish accuracy by depth band. Refuse low-confidence matches instead of guessing. Never recommend lighter than measured.
flags: BRAND DATA: matching to real foundations needs YouCam product data or brand permission
DATA: banded accuracy needs spectrophotometer-verified shade values (not available)

features.name: Concealer Shade + Placement Maps
features.summary: Which concealer shade, exactly where, how much, in what order — mapped on her face.
features.must: No default 'brighten 3 shades' triangle. Deep-skin circles need orange-family correction, not lighter concealer, which greys.

features.name: Colour Correction Maps
features.summary: A personal green/peach/orange/lavender map: right corrector, right place, right thinness — then what goes over it.
features.must: Correctors on deep skin must be saturated enough — pastel correctors ash out. Include a visible 'too much' warning state.

features.name: Cream vs Powder Finish Simulator
features.summary: The same blush, bronzer or foundation rendered as cream and as powder — on her skin texture.
features.must: Honest on mature and textured skin — powder must visibly settle, not be flattered flat. Deep-skin powder must not ash.

features.name: Finish Switcher: Dewy / Matte / Skin-Tint
features.summary: One base, three finishes and coverages, rendered honestly — including shine zones.
features.must: No skin lightening in any finish. Freckles and pigmentation remain visible under skin-tint.

features.name: Blush Placement By Face Shape
features.summary: Draped, lifted, sun-kissed or apples — placed from her geometry, with shade depth-corrected.
features.must: Blush must be visible on deep skin — most apps render it at light-skin opacity and it vanishes. No placement that drags a long face longer without labelling the effect.

features.name: Bronzer / Contour Maps Per Face Shape
features.summary: Where she bronzes and contours — and where she should not.
features.must: Contour shade never grey on warm or deep skin. No automatic face-slimming — contour is opt-in colour and shadow; geometry untouched (CE-1).

features.name: Makeup Recreator From A Reference Photo
features.summary: Upload any look photo; get it rebuilt on her face, itemised into steps and products.
features.must: Credit and consent framing for reference photos of real people. Colours are adapted, not copied raw — a lip that works on the reference depth is re-solved, not pasted.
flags: MODEL NOT CLEARED: makeup parsing from a reference photo has no cleared model (attachment: no off-the-shelf solution)

features.name: Celebrity / Red-Carpet Look Recreator, Step-By-Step
features.summary: Named-event looks rebuilt as a timed, ordered routine on her face.
features.must: No implication the celebrity endorses it. Adaptation for hooded, monolid and deep-set eyes and for deep skin is the product, not an afterthought.
flags: RULE: no celebrity names or likenesses (third-party names rule)
substitute: generic red-carpet style looks
features.blocked_reason: Celebrity names and likenesses break the third-party names rule and publicity rights. Substitute: generic red-carpet style looks with our own names (planned as W14-sub).

features.name: Bridal Trial Suite
features.summary: The full bridal look tested for photos, tears/sweat longevity, daylight and venue light — with a day-of spec.
features.must: Render deep skin under flash honestly — flashback ashes deep skin worst. No airbrushed 'bridal glow' that erases the texture in the trial photo she shows her artist.

features.name: No-Makeup Makeup Calibrator
features.summary: The minimum product, in the minimum places, to hit 'rested' — calibrated down, not up.
features.must: Success is defined as her skin visible. It never adds slimming, lashes or eye enlargement — the usual 'natural' filter cheats.

features.name: Foundation Oxidation Simulator
features.summary: How this shade will actually look 30–60 minutes after application.
features.must: Estimates labelled as estimates, per formula. The orange shift is shown honestly on fair and olive skin, where it is most visible.
flags: DATA: per-formula oxidation data needs brand data

features.name: Seasonal Shade Rematch + Mixing Ratio
features.summary: Her summer/winter shade pair — and the drop ratio to mix between them.
features.must: Tanning-aware without encouraging UV tanning — framed around measured depth, including self-tan state (#78). On deep skin the seasonal shift is mostly undertone and chroma, not just depth.

features.name: Clip-In Extensions Preview
features.summary: Length in inches + volume + blend, at her texture — before buying a $150–$500 set.
features.must: Curly and coily blends keep pattern and shrinkage — length is shown stretched and worn, both. The hairline blend must not lighten deep skin.
flags: MODEL NOT CLEARED: new hair synthesis needs a cleared generative model

features.name: Tape-In / Sew-In Extensions Preview
features.summary: The installed look, the placement rows, and the maintenance reality — before $300–$2,000.
features.must: Honest fine/thinning-hair warnings — tape-ins can show, and can damage. Sew-in previews respect textured hair and never default to straight wefts.
flags: MODEL NOT CLEARED: same as W19

features.name: Hair Topper Preview
features.summary: Coverage area, base size and part realism for thinning at the part or crown.
features.must: Dignity-first UX, private by default, no 'baldness' language. The part must match her skin depth — the lace-tint problem is the #1 giveaway on deep skin.

features.name: Wig Preview (Fashion)
features.summary: Cut, colour, lace and part on her head shape — with fit cues.
features.must: Lace must be tintable across Monk 1–10. Coily textures in the library at launch parity, not later.

features.name: Root Touch-Up Spray/Powder Preview
features.summary: Will this root product actually cover — and will the shade halo?
features.must: Grey on dark hair needs full-opacity simulation. Transfer and scalp show-through shown honestly.

features.name: Thinning Hairline Filler + Scalp Concealer Preview
features.summary: Hairline, temple and part filler — the density illusion checked at photo distance.
features.must: Never render a straight, sharp 'ideal' hairline over hers. Sensitive, non-medical framing — a cosmetic filler preview, no regrowth claims.

features.name: Density Fibres Simulation
features.summary: The keratin-fibre effect at crown and part, by shake amount, in her shade.
features.must: Show the daylight failure mode, not just the flattering one. Grey and salt-and-pepper fibre mixes supported.

features.name: Semi-Permanent Tint Preview
features.summary: Deposit-only colour that fades: today, wash 4, wash 8.
features.must: On dark bases, show the honest subtle result — never fake lightness a deposit cannot achieve.

features.name: Colour Gloss + Toner For Brassiness
features.summary: Will a gloss or toner fix this brass — and which tone: ash, violet or pearl?
features.must: Works on lightened textured hair too. Never promise that toner can lift — it can only deposit and neutralise, and the label says so.

features.name: Balayage Placement Painter
features.summary: She (or her stylist) paints where the lightening goes; face-frame, density and lift rendered.
features.must: Lift limits by base depth and previous colour history — dark bases cannot reach icy blonde in one session, and the preview shows session-1 reality. Curl pattern preserved through lightening.

features.name: Money Piece Preview
features.summary: Face-frame brightness, width and intensity, checked against her skin.
features.must: On deep skin and dark bases, show the required session count honestly. On coily hair, the frame follows her worn part and style.

features.name: Lowlights / Babylights / Foil Placement Maps
features.summary: Dimension design as an exportable foil map.
features.must: Lowlights on blonde must not render green or ash by accident — the Lab solver keeps warmth controlled. Textured-hair foil placement follows curl clumps.

features.name: Chunky Highlights + Lived-In Colour
features.summary: Bold 90s/Y2K panels vs soft lived-in grow-out, on the same head.
features.must: Chunky on dark bases means high contrast — show the bleach-session reality. Lived-in keeps her natural root colour at the root, not a generic brown.

features.name: Grey Blending Preview
features.summary: Highlights, lowlights and demi that soften the regrowth line — at her actual grey %.
features.must: Her silver is the hero colour, never recoloured away by default. A yellowed-silver toning option is shown separately.

features.name: Grey Transition Timeline Simulator
features.summary: Month-by-month grow-out to full natural grey, with intervention options per month.
features.must: No pressure either way — the 'keep colouring' cost and time comparison renders just as neutrally. Works for dark bases, where the contrast is harshest.

features.name: Colour Melt / Ombré
features.summary: Gradient root-to-tip colour with a melt point and tone she controls.
features.must: The gradient starts from her real root colour. On short hair, warn when the length cannot support a melt.

features.name: Split Dye
features.summary: Half/half or panel splits, the boundary placed on her part, both sides solved independently.
features.must: A black side over previously lightened hair fades green/blue — the fade state is rendered. A coily split follows her worn style, not a centre-part template.

features.name: Peekaboo Colour
features.summary: Hidden underlayer colour, visible only in movement or updos — previewed hidden and revealed.
features.must: Bleed-through check on fine and light top layers. The vivid fade curve (#26 model) is shown.
flags: MODEL NOT CLEARED: hair-layer segmentation has no cleared model

features.name: Bangs / Fringe Previews
features.summary: Curtain, blunt, wispy, side, micro — at her hairline, density and curl.
features.must: Never render curly hair's fringe straight. Forehead-height honesty — a micro fringe on a short forehead is labelled.

features.name: Haircut Previews By Face Shape
features.summary: Cuts recommended from her geometry and texture — not a celebrity gallery.
features.must: Spring-up applied — cuts shown at dry length. Fine and thin hair get volume honesty; no borrowed density.
flags: MODEL NOT CLEARED: cut synthesis needs a cleared generative model unless YouCam hairstyle covers it

features.name: Curl-Pattern-Respecting Recolour
features.summary: Any colour in this app, rendered on a 2A–4C pattern without straightening it.
features.must: Geometry-lock test: the before/after curl silhouette is identical. This feature is the audit the whole hair section passes or fails on.
flags: MODEL NOT CLEARED: needs a textured-hair (2A-4C) dataset and renderer
no cleared dataset yet. Until then YouCam hair colour plus local Lab texture graft, tested on curly-hair slices

features.name: Frizz Control + Curl Definition Preview
features.summary: Define curls and smooth frizz without straightening: a product-effect simulation.
features.must: Volume is not frizz — the silhouette stays. No default straightening anywhere in the flow. 4C definition is rendered as coil definition, not loosened curls — pattern-loosening is a known harm.

features.name: Postpartum Regrowth Simulation
features.summary: Temple and hairline regrowth timeline, with styling and filler options month by month.
features.must: Medical-adjacent care: it visualises typical cosmetic timelines, is not medical advice, and flags patchy or persistent loss as 'see a clinician'. Supportive tone, never fear-selling.

features.name: Chemo-Sensitive Wig + Scalp Tools
features.summary: Private, gentle wig, topper and scarf previews with cap-comfort information — timed before hair loss.
features.must: Maximum privacy: on-device, no cloud retention, no ads, no before/after sharing prompts. No medical claims. Insurance 'cranial prosthesis' coverage raised as information only.
flags: CO-DESIGN: as W88
private by default, no share prompts, no cloud retention

features.name: Heat Styling Previews
features.summary: Silk press, blowout and beach waves on her texture — with heat-commitment honesty.
features.must: Labelled as a temporary style, with her pattern shown returning. No implication of permanent change; a heat-damage education note, with no damage-prediction claims.

features.name: Humidity-Proof Hair Forecast
features.summary: How today's style and colour will behave at today's dew point, by hour.
features.must: Estimates labelled, no false precision. Dew point — not just % humidity — drives the model, per textured-hair expertise.
flags: DATA: weather forecast needs a free, no-card API (ASSUMED Open-Meteo
licence to check)

features.name: Fuller Lips With Shape Control
features.summary: Volume placed by zone — cupid's bow, keyhole, Russian lift, natural plump — not a single 'bigger' slider.
features.must: Caps at anatomically plausible ranges. Her lip texture and asymmetry preserved (CE-2). Nothing applied by default — she chooses a style deliberately.
flags: 18+ GATE: procedure preview
age model not cleared, so self-declared 18+ plus the conservative fallback

features.name: Realistic Lip Liner Overline Simulation
features.summary: Overline that survives scrutiny: where it works (cupid's bow), where it betrays (corners), by lighting.
features.must: The close-up and daylight failure is shown honestly. On two-tone or deep lips, liner shade is solved against both lip tones (#57).

features.name: Lip Tint / Lip Blush / Permanent-Makeup Preview
features.summary: The healed result — not day 1 — with fade over 12–18 months.
features.must: Professional-consult framing, patch-test and healing information, no booking in-app. Deep-lip healing honesty is the differentiator.

features.name: Lip Flip Preview
features.summary: Subtle upper-lip eversion only — shown smiling and at rest, with duration and cost context.
features.must: Smallest-effect honesty — for many users 'barely different' is the valuable answer. Never paired with purchase prompts.
flags: 18+ GATE: as W45

features.name: Lip Filler Volume Preview By Dose
features.summary: 0.5 ml / 1 ml-style increments, in the settled-at-2-weeks state — not day-1 swelling.
features.must: Hard caps. Consult-preview framing with risk information (migration, lumps, vascular events exist — see Risks). No 'book now' commerce; an injector consultation is encouraged.
flags: 18+ GATE: as W45

features.name: Gummy Smile Adjustment Preview
features.summary: Gum-show reduction options — lip, gum line, tooth length — shown comparatively.
features.must: Dental-consult framing, no diagnosis — causes vary (jaw, lip, gum) and that is stated. Smile dynamics vary, so the static preview is labelled as such.
flags: MODEL NOT CLEARED: teeth/gum segmentation
18+ GATE: as W45

features.name: Veneers Preview
features.summary: Per-tooth shape, shade and length across the 6–8 tooth smile zone — porcelain vs composite.
features.must: Irreversibility stated plainly — enamel removal. Shade honesty, no toilet-white default. Consult export (#93 dental variant).
flags: MODEL NOT CLEARED: teeth mesh and material render
18+ GATE: as W45

features.name: Tooth Gap Close / Open Preview
features.summary: Diastema closed, partially closed, or kept — at her choice, with a midline check.
features.must: 'Keep my gap' is a first-class outcome, with styling (lip shades that celebrate it). No beauty-score language.
flags: MODEL NOT CLEARED: needs W51 teeth segmentation
18+ GATE: as W45

features.name: Tooth Length/Shape + Gum Line Design
features.summary: Feminine, strong or soft tooth character plus a scalloped gum line — designed together.
features.must: Dental-consult framing. Gum changes are surgical — never framed as an edit she can simply 'get' without a dentist.
flags: MODEL NOT CLEARED: needs W51
18+ GATE: as W45

features.name: Lip Shades That Make Teeth Look Whiter
features.summary: Blue-based vs orange-based lip colour: optical tooth-whitening, shown — teeth untouched.
features.must: Teeth are never actually whitened in this feature — that honesty is the point. Works with user-declared stained or veneered teeth states.

features.name: Lipstick Finish Switcher
features.summary: Matte / satin / gloss / stain in the same shade, texture-true.
features.must: Matte must show lip lines, not blur them. A stain on two-tone lips must blend asymmetrically, as real stains do.

features.name: Lip Wear-Off Simulation
features.summary: After 2 hours, after coffee, after a meal: centre fade, ring, transfer.
features.must: Labelled as finish-class estimates, not per-product promises. Centre fade on deep lips shown with contrast honesty.

features.name: Lip Colour On Real Lip Pigmentation
features.summary: Try-on that starts from her lip colour — including two-tone and melanin-rich lips.
features.must: Never normalise her lips to pink first. Liner pairing (#46) offered, not forced.

features.name: Smile In Motion Check
features.summary: A short video preview: lips, teeth and gum as she talks and smiles — for any smile/lip preview above.
features.must: Temporal stability is the acceptance test — no flicker or swimming. Labelled an approximation; real dynamics need a professional consult.
flags: MODEL NOT CLEARED: video version of W45-W53

features.name: Lash Extension Preview By Style
features.summary: Classic / hybrid / volume / mega — with the lash map diagram a tech would use.
features.must: Renders correctly on hooded, deep-set and monolid eyes — lashes emerge from her lash line, not a template eye. Volume on very sparse natural lashes is labelled unrealistic.
flags: MODEL NOT CLEARED: lash rendering model is new

features.name: Lash Styling By Eye Shape
features.summary: Cat eye / doll eye / wispy / kitten / fox — solved for her eye shape, with the why.
features.must: Downturned and hooded warnings are prominent, not footnotes. Monolid expertise is built with, not bolted on.

features.name: Lash Lift & Tint Preview
features.summary: Her own lashes, lifted (by curl type) and tinted — no added lashes.
features.must: Length is hers — never silently lengthened. Straight, downward lashes (common in East Asian eyes) get the biggest honest transformation, and the model must handle them.

features.name: Strip / Cluster Lash Try-On
features.summary: Buyable strip and DIY cluster styles, sized to her eye width.
features.must: Lashes sit on her lash line at her eye size — no one-size overlay. Glasses wearers get a collision warning (#86).

features.name: Mascara By Type
features.summary: Lengthening vs volumising vs tubing, on her lashes — including lower lashes and the smudge state.
features.must: No lash count invented. Sparse lashes stay sparse — just coated.

features.name: Eyeliner Wing By Eye Shape
features.summary: Wing angle and length solved per eye — including the hooded batwing — plus tightline.
features.must: Monolid, hooded and deep-set eyes each get native techniques. Symmetry assistance without forcing symmetric eyes — real eyes differ.

features.name: Graphic + Smokey Eyeliner
features.summary: Floating crease, double wing, smoked pencil vs gel vs shadow — blend level she controls.
features.must: Graphic shapes stay inside her mobile-lid real estate. On deep skin, black liner's contrast is lower — offer brown/bronze depth honestly rather than thickening the line.

features.name: Eyeshadow Techniques
features.summary: Cut crease, halo, classic smokey — placed on her crease, or built where no crease shows.
features.must: Pigment payoff scaled by skin depth — pastels intensified, not vanished, on deep lids, and labelled when a shade cannot perform. Eye-shape variants are native.

features.name: Foiled / Duochrome Shadow Light-Shift Preview
features.summary: Colour that flips with angle and light — shown moving, not as a flat swatch.
features.must: The flip must survive on deep lids — base transparency modelled. No glitter invented beyond the product class.

features.name: Coloured Contact Lenses
features.summary: Natural enhancement on dark eyes first: limbal, hazel, grey, green that actually reads.
features.must: The dark-eye result is the headline render, not a footnote. Eye-health information included (lenses are medical devices — a fitting/prescription note), with no lenses sold in-app.

features.name: Brow Tint Preview
features.summary: Tint depth matched to hair and skin — including the too-dark first-week state.
features.must: Tint cannot create hairs that don't exist — sparse areas stay sparse (that is #71/#72 territory, cross-linked). Grey brow hairs resist tint, and that shows.

features.name: Brow Lamination Preview
features.summary: Brushed-up, set brows at her hair length and coarseness — including 'too much for you' honesty.
features.must: Sparse or short brows get a truthful minimal result plus an alternative suggestion. No skin smoothing under the brow.
flags: MODEL NOT CLEARED: brow hair-flow model is new

features.name: Microblading Preview
features.summary: Hair-stroke brows, stroke by stroke — healed and faded states, on her brow bone.
features.must: PMU professional-consult framing, no medical claims. The healed state is the default view — fresh is the misleading one. Deep-skin pigment honesty.
flags: 18+ GATE: as W45

features.name: Powder / Nano Brow Preview
features.summary: Soft-shaded powder brows and machine nano strokes — compared against microblading on her face.
features.must: Consult framing as #71. Powder density capped — no 'Instagram block brow' default.
flags: 18+ GATE: as W45

features.name: Brow Shape By Face Shape
features.summary: Arch height and peak, tail length, thickness — from her geometry, before any tint or PMU.
features.must: Never auto-thin. Asymmetry respected ('sisters, not twins'). Mature brows (tail droop) handled without 'lifting' promises.

features.name: Lash / Brow Serum Progress Simulator
features.summary: Realistic month-by-month expectations (length, density) — not a before/after ad.
features.must: No efficacy claims — 'typical reported ranges; your result varies; this is not medical advice'. Prostaglandin-class side-effect information (reported iris/skin darkening) surfaced neutrally, with 'ask a professional'. A trust feature, not a sales feature.

features.name: Makeup For Hooded / Monolid / Deep-Set Eyes
features.summary: A dedicated placement engine — not a toggle.
features.must: Designed and tested with artists and models of each anatomy. It never 'corrects' the eye shape — it adapts the makeup only (CE-1).

features.name: Coloured Eyeliner + Mascara Preview
features.summary: Navy, burgundy, forest — the low-commitment colour entry, on her eye colour.
features.must: The brown-eyed majority is treated as first-class — most colour-theory content is made for blue and green eyes.

features.name: Skin Tint & Tinted Moisturiser Matching
features.summary: Sheer products matched by undertone — with the coverage honesty sheer products need.
features.must: 'Forgive depth, never undertone.' Deep-skin tint ranges are the shortest — say when no good match exists in a brand rather than forcing one.

features.name: Self-Tan Preview By Shade/Depth
features.summary: DHA-depth preview on her undertone: light/medium/dark, olive vs orange base.
features.must: Never frame tanning as 'healthier'. Deep skin included (the glow/even-out use case, with subtler depth steps). Patchiness-risk zones (dry areas absorb more) visualised.

features.name: Self-Tan Face–Body Match
features.summary: Face, neck, chest and hands at one depth — with drop-count for face products.
features.must: A hands/knuckle over-absorption warning, visualised. Colour only — no body-image commentary.

features.name: SPF White-Cast Checker
features.summary: Will this sunscreen cast on her depth? Mineral, tinted and chemical rendered at real application amount.
features.must: No SPF efficacy claims or dosing advice beyond the cosmetic cast preview. The feature's job is finding one she'll wear.
flags: BRAND DATA: SPF product data needs brand data

features.name: Hyperpigmentation / Melasma-Aware Concealing
features.summary: A coverage plan that conceals without the grey cast — and without claiming to treat.
features.must: Strictly cosmetic concealing — no diagnosis, no treatment or efficacy claims, no labelling her face 'melasma' (the UI says 'areas of deeper pigmentation you marked'). Heat/sun triggers noted as general information only.

features.name: Rosacea-Aware Colour Correction
features.summary: A redness map that respects flare patterns and sensitivity — less product, where it counts.
features.must: Cosmetic only, no diagnosis ('persistent redness' language, a clinician signposted for diagnosis), no ingredient treatment claims. Sensitivity-first copy.

features.name: Hormonal / Cycle Skin Diary Visualisation
features.summary: Her photos, aligned and lit consistently, mapped to her cycle — so she sees her own pattern.
features.must: Health-data privacy: on-device, exportable, deletable; no fertility or medical predictions, no diagnosis. Irregular cycles and menopause/perimenopause states handled without forcing a 28-day model.
flags: HEALTH DATA: cycle data on-device only, deletable, never ad-tech

features.name: Menopause Skin Mode
features.summary: Base and makeup re-solved for thinner, drier, more reactive skin — what changes in application, visually.
features.engine: Reuse — re-tunes #9/#10/#16; high impact per effort
features.must: Pro-age framing, zero 'anti-ageing/erase' language. Adult acne and dryness at the same time is normal here, and the solver handles both.
flags: CO-DESIGN: as W88

features.name: Jewellery & Earrings Try-On
features.summary: Scale-true earrings and necklaces, metal tone solved against undertone.
features.must: Weight and length honesty (long drops vs a short neck). Hijab-compatible styling linked (#88 — earrings over/under-scarf styles).

features.summary: Frames that fit her bridge, width and brow line — at true scale.
features.overlap: none (55/56 are glare and removal, not try-on)
features.must: Fit warnings prominent. Fit language only — no face-shape 'flaws' language.

features.name: Nail Colour Matching To A Look
features.summary: Polish shades solved against her skin undertone and today's makeup/outfit.
features.must: A nude range across Monk 1–10 at launch. Nail length and shape untouched — colour only (CE-1 for hands).

features.summary: Hijab colours and drapes solved against undertone and makeup — the face-framing effect shown.

features.name: Occasion Look Bundles
features.summary: Date night / interview / wedding guest: complete, context-appropriate looks in one tap — then editable.
features.must: The interview bundle must not default to 'more makeup = more competent' framing — she sets her own polish level. Cultural and religious context respected (#88).

features.name: Freckle Preservation + Faux Freckles
features.summary: Base that keeps her freckles visible — or freckles added that sit in skin, not on it.
features.must: Preservation is ON by default in 'natural' modes. Faux freckles never appear in a 'no-makeup' preset without labelling.

features.name: Neck / Chest Blend + Continuity Checker
features.summary: The jawline tide-mark, caught before she leaves the house.
features.must: Colour only — no body commentary. Lighting-normalised (CE-6), so a shadow isn't misread as a mismatch.

features.name: Mature-Skin Makeup Mode (Texture-First)
features.summary: Every placement and finish re-derived for lines, crepey lids and changing brows and lips.
features.must: Texture is kept in every render — the mode fails if she looks 30. Representation in the test panel is the acceptance criterion.

features.name: Salon Decision Pack
features.summary: One-tap export spec sheet to show a stylist, dentist or tech: shades, placements, maps, her photos.
features.engine: Reuse — aggregation; the feature professionals will recommend
features.must: Her data, her control — share links expire, no stylist-side upsell data. Her unedited photo is always page 1: the preview never travels without the reality it started from.

features.name: Salon Price Estimator
features.summary: For this previewed service, on her hair/face, in her city: range, sessions, and a year-1 maintenance total.
features.must: No false precision. No affiliate steering to partner salons without disclosure.
flags: DATA: salon price ranges from published lists, shown as estimates with source and city

features.name: Product Allergy Flags
features.summary: Her allergen list checked against every recommended product's ingredients — including salon chemistry (PPD, fragrance, latex, acrylates).
features.must: Flags are information, not medical clearance — 'no flag ≠ safe for you'. Patch tests and professional advice urged. Allergen data sourced carefully; it is liability-sensitive.
flags: DATA: INCI ingredient database licence not checked

features.name: Save Looks By Occasion
features.summary: A wardrobe of looks: named, occasion-tagged, versioned — with the products and maps that created them.
features.must: The recipe survives product discontinuation — it falls back to the Lab shade plus the nearest current match (#3).

features.name: Shopping List From A Look, In Her Undertone
features.summary: Buy exactly this look: items, shades, dupes, allergy-checked, totalled.
features.must: 'Don't buy' honesty is the trust engine. No sponsored reordering of matches.
flags: BRAND DATA: as W3

features.name: Lighting Simulator
features.summary: See any look in daylight, office and evening light — and camera flash — before committing.
features.must: A simulator that only flatters is a filter. This one must be able to fail a look.

features.name: Grow-Out / Maintenance Calendar
features.summary: What this look costs and looks like at week 2, 6 and 12: regrowth, fade, fills, toners, touch-ups.
features.must: The calendar sells nothing — no rebooking commerce without disclosure. Every service shows a 'letting it grow out gracefully' path.

features.name: Shade Passport
features.summary: Her portable, measured identity for colour: depth, undertone, per-brand shades, hair base and history, allergens.
features.must: Privacy by design: on-device first, encrypted export, granular consent, delete means delete. Accuracy dates shown — a 2-year-old passport is stale and prompts a re-measure.
flags: BIOMETRIC DATA: on-device by default, encrypted user-initiated export, real deletion
